name: Mamoru
source:
A young boy who survived a catastrophic event that devastated his village.
Fortuitously discovered by the Kamishiro family, he was taken in and raised as one of their own, eventually becoming a loyal servant to the household.
Having forged strong bonds with the three main heroines throughout their shared upbringing, Mamoru is fiercely committed to safeguarding them from any foes they may face.
